hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),os=require('os');const root=process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||process.cwd();const p=path.join(root,'.claude','settings.local.json');const want=path.join(root,'memory');const eq=(a,b)=>{a=path.resolve(a);b=path.resolve(b);return process.platform==='win32'?a.toLowerCase()===b.toLowerCase():a===b;};let msg='';try{const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));let d=s.autoMemoryDirectory;if(d&&d.startsWith('~/'))d=path.join(os.homedir(),d.slice(2));if(!d)msg='autoMemoryDirectory is not set';else if(!path.isAbsolute(d))msg='autoMemoryDirectory ('+d+') must be an absolute path or start with ~/';else if(!eq(d,want))msg='autoMemoryDirectory ('+d+') does not point to the in-repo memory/ folder ('+want+')';else if(!fs.existsSync(d))msg='autoMemoryDirectory folder is missing: '+d;}catch(e){msg='cannot read '+p+' ('+e.message+')';}if(msg)console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'⚠ Memory pointer check FAILED: '+msg+'. Set autoMemoryDirectory in .claude/settings.local.json to the absolute path of the in-repo memory/ folder.',hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SessionStart',additionalContext:'Memory pointer check failed: '+msg+' The agent should offer to restore the autoMemoryDirectory pointer in .claude/settings.local.json.'}}));"
